look_here_first: Think evergreen cherry: a small evergreen tree with glossy leathery alternate leaves, short axillary racemes of small white flowers, black drupes, and a bitter-almond odor when fresh twigs are scratched.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: short axillary racemes of small white flowers

lookalikes.differences: Separate from P. serotina by evergreen glossy foliage and shorter axillary racemes; separate from P. mexicana by evergreen habit, glossy leaves, and cherry-like black fruit rather than larger plum-like drupes.
